title: WHEN WORK FEELS
UNFRUITFUL
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: golden sunlit valley with quiet river
quiet rustic sanctuary stone table sunlit
sunlit wheat field in quiet valley
calm mountain river in golden morning light

scenes.a: You wonder if your work will bear fruit.
You have planted your labor, tended your fields, and waited through dry seasons with a quiet heart.
Hear the word of Psalm 85 verse 12.
Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
Father, we bring our daily work to Your table today. Where we see empty ground, You see an approaching harvest.
Teach us to trust Your steady supply, bless the effort of our hands, and give what is good in Your perfect timing.
scenes.sub: BLESS THE WORK OF OUR HANDS

scenes.a: We rest in Your faithful care. Amen. You wonder if your work will bear fruit.
